text: Internal medicine is a core basic discipline of clinical medicine. It takes the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases in various human systems (such as cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, kidney, etc.) as its research objects, and focuses on managing diseases through non-surgical means such as drug treatment and lifestyle intervention. The training objective is to enable students to master systematic clinical thinking methods, possess the ability to independently diagnose and handle common and frequently-occurring diseases in internal medicine (such as hypertension, diabetes, and pneumonia), and be able to collaborate with multiple disciplines such as surgery and radiology in complex cases. At the same time, they should have the basic qualities to conduct clinical research (such as chronic disease management and precise treatment).
